highlights: Infosecurity Magazine Home » News » Symantec Uncovers AI Agent Hijacking Models for Autonomous Cyber-Attacks. # Symantec Uncovers AI Agent Hijacking Models for Autonomous Cyber-Attacks. A new AI agent developed to run a full cyber-attack without human intervention has been uncovered by security researchers. The agent was designed to use hijacked AI models to autonomously run up to 100,000 malicious actions without human approval, including scanning for targets, exploiting vulnerabilities, stealing credentials, deploying cryptocurrency miners and reinfecting compromised systems. Researchers from the Symantec Threat Hunter Team found the malicious agent using an AI honeypot – a system that impersonates an unprotected, internet-facing AI service in order to attract and study attacks against AI infrastructure. They captured the agent's full instruction set in the summer of 2026, revealing how it was designed to operate autonomously, although the honeypot did not execute the attacker's tools.
